SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
1626 South Throop Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 1626 South Throop Street from an RT-4 Residential Two-
Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to
bring the existing density and bulk characteristics into compliance with the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance. The subject property is improved with a three-and-a-half-story
multifamily residential building with 9 dwelling units and a two-story coach house with
7 dwelling units for a total density of 16 dwelling units. Because there is a lack of permit
history, the Applicant simply seeks to legalize the existing density. The exterior of the
building and the use will remain unchanged, and no commercial space will be provided.
The principal building’s height of 40 feet and 9 inches and the coach house height of 27
feet and 9 inches will remain unchanged.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks the following variations: (1) to
reduce the required minimum lot area per dwelling unit by 10% from 200 to 180 pursuant
to Section 17-13-1101-R; (2) to reduce following setbacks: (i) front setback to zero, (ti) the
north, south, and combined side setbacks to 0 feet, and (iii) rear setback to 0 feet pursuant
to Section 17-13-1101-B. The Applicant also seeks an administrative adjustment to reduce
the parking requirements to 0 pursuant to Section 17-13-1003-EE. Furthermore, the
Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, for the attached plans.
